email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Flexi-job Social Media Content Creator position at The ASH. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in content creation, social media integration, and SEO, I am excited about the opportunity to bring The ASH's unique atmosphere to life on Instagram and TikTok.

In my current role at Episto, I create keyword-targeted content and manage WordPress sites, which has honed my ability to produce engaging, detail-oriented content. On my own project, mirook.com, I've implemented social media integration and structured data to improve visibility. I am comfortable filming with a smartphone, editing with CapCut, and using Canva for design. I am also fluent in English and have a B1 level in Dutch, which I am actively improving.

I am social, creative, and not afraid to approach guests for spontaneous content. I stay on top of trends and enjoy bringing fresh ideas to the table. I would love to contribute to The ASH's community and help grow its online presence.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can add value to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com
